Question 6
?

Find the general solution to the equation x2y″+4xy′+2y=0,x>0.

a
y(x)=c1x−2+c2x−3
b
y(x)=c1x2+c2x
c
y(x)=c1+c2x−1
d
y(x)=c1x−2+c2x−1
e
y(x)=c1x2+c2x−2
